policy.source: read-only synthetic originals; sanitized allowlisted projection for external tools
policy.inventoryContract: draft-F28-poc-v1, explicit normalized paths/root identity/revision/exclusions; no production implementation

decisionThresholds.adopt: all scoped semantics and isolation/read-only gates pass within budgets
decisionThresholds.bounded_adopt: safe subset supported; every unsupported semantic/platform explicitly excluded and alternative selected
decisionThresholds.reject: isolation/read-only/accuracy/platform or mandatory lifecycle gate cannot be satisfied without weakening controls

adapterContract.semantics: import is never call; unresolved/inferred never promoted to observed; original schema JSON is not writable PAOS state

wireframe.design: existing V3 components/tokens; isolated prototype, no production nav wiring
wireframe.desktop: compact project/mode/coverage bar; object outline | graph/list/Mermaid | evidence inspector
wireframe.mobile: mode/search then useful list or focused graph; collapsible outline/inspector; source/revision/coverage visible
wireframe.navigation: Files -> Map -> Database -> source line -> Back; project changes clear incompatible selections
wireframe.accessibility: keyboard selection/search, readable labels, table alternative, explicit zoom/reset and focus restoration
wireframe.persistentState: prototype URL query only; no browser persistence or credentials

evidence: source-owned task Completion Reports and docs domain pages; raw synthetic measurements in .tmp/func-g02; no copied private prompts/logs
